metadata.source: Top-4 from 32ch ranked selections + intersection configs

attention.description: Top-4 channels from 32ch Attention (CBraMod gradient) ranking. Standard single-method selection for channel scaling analysis.

fdr.description: Top-4 channels from 32ch FDR (Fisher Discriminant Ratio) ranking. Standard single-method selection for channel scaling analysis.

fdr_attention_overlap.description: 4 channels at the intersection of 32ch FDR (Fisher Discriminant Ratio) and 32ch Attention (EEGNet spatial conv + CBraMod gradient) selections. These represent channels jointly identified by both statistical separability and neural network attention.

negative_control.description: Negative control — 4 random channels from the complement of all 5 tested 32ch configs (commercial, fdr, csp, attention, band_power) union (seed=42)
